purpose: Stop treating learning benchmarks as the primary objective. Use JUXTAPOSE, JGPT, Pivot-Slime, M2R-PM, TOPA Detective Spider, Pippi and MAD-LAB as theorem-extraction and counterexample machinery.

primary_target.name: POLYNOMIAL_COMPLETE_PIVOT_GRAMMAR
primary_target.statement_candidate: For every relevant reachable canonical nonterminal CNF state F, construct in polynomial time a polynomial-size grammar G(F) of structural pivot classes that contains at least one next pivot admitting a correctness-preserving transition with polynomially bounded intermediate state and eventual polynomial progress.

proof_obligation_chain.goal: For every relevant reachable nonterminal F, at least one pivot belongs to a polynomially describable safe class.
proof_obligation_chain.formal_shape: forall F in Reachable: nonterminal(F) => exists v in Vars(F): R(F,v)

proof_obligation_chain.goal: R-classes and G(F) are computable and enumerable in polynomial time and polynomial space.
Select an R-valid pivot deterministically in polynomial time without exhaustive exponential search.
proof_obligation_chain.formal_shape: selector(F,G(F)) -> v with R(F,v) in poly(|F|)

proof_obligation_chain.goal: Every selected transition keeps the canonical and charged intermediate representation polynomially bounded.
A well-founded potential decreases sufficiently to limit the trajectory to polynomially many selected transitions.
Combine correctness, selector, state and progress bounds into a deterministic polynomial SAT algorithm.
proof_obligation_chain.promotion_rule: Only a symbolic proof of all previous obligations can promote this gate.

first_attack.reason: If universal safe-pivot availability fails, later selector/progress proofs are irrelevant. Kill the route as early as possible if false.
first_attack.known_warning: Local degree/polarity statistics alone are insufficient; canonical 25:25 and larger balanced cores can exist while exact elimination behavior varies strongly with clause structure.
first_attack.required_counterexample_scope: FULL_REACHABLE_CONCRETE_CANONICAL_CNF, not root-only and not aggregate-only

roles.JUXTAPOSE: Full exact pivot-field coverage when needed; generate bounded counterexample landscapes; never itself constitute proof.
roles.JGPT: Propose structural predicates, candidate lemmas and compressed grammar descriptions from exact receipts.
roles.PIVOT_SLIME: Search local neighborhoods of candidate predicates and pivot structures; feed failures and successes back to Pippi.
roles.M2R_PM: Remember exact positive and negative structural episodes; prevent rediscovery of killed rules.
roles.TOPA_DETECTIVE_SPIDER: Spider mines relations/attention centers; TOPA CORE attacks confounding, leakage and false causal interpretation.
roles.PIPPI: Append-only theorem-search journal: provenance, killed lemmas, surviving proof obligations, resource accounting and mirror state.
roles.KEYMASTER: Allocate attack effort across candidate lemmas and exact pivot probes; no proof authority.
roles.MAD_LAB: Adversarial counterexample generator and scope auditor.

stop_doing_as_primary_work: empty learning races whose only output is another performance percentage
benchmark scaling without a named proof obligation
collecting more finite successes after the relevant structural hypothesis is already identified
tuning advisers unless a tuning defect blocks theorem extraction or counterexample search

next_concrete_task.name: SAFE_PIVOT_AVAILABILITY_MINIMAL_COUNTEREXAMPLE_SEARCH
next_concrete_task.instruction: Define the weakest nontrivial structural predicate R(F,v) suggested by exact receipts; enumerate/construct full concrete canonical reachable states in increasing size; use JUXTAPOSE to test every pivot; if all pivots violate R or polynomial safety, freeze the minimal counterexample. If no counterexample survives bounded search, translate R into a symbolic lemma and attack its proof assumptions.
next_concrete_task.success: Either a minimal counterexample that kills/refines PO1, or a sharply stated symbolic lemma with explicit assumptions and no empirical language.
